The Local Area Plans and Community Plans are approved by Minister of Energy, Mines and Resources and Cabinet as a Policy Document. Newer joint Local Area Plans are approved in the same manner for non Settlement Land and by First Nation Chief and Council for Settlement Land.

Distributed from [GeoYukon](https://yukon.ca/geoyukon) by the [Government of Yukon](https://yukon.ca/maps) . Discover more digital map data and interactive maps from Yukon's digital map data collection.
